name: Almighty Sonoxo Research Ontology
axioms: Every source remains attributed to its original author or assignee.
Patent-derived concepts are prior art or inspiration, not automatically original invention.
Every promoted claim has an evidence record.
A human/policy gate precedes consequential real-world actuation.
Weapon targeting, payload actuation, detonators, and autonomous kinetic authority are excluded.
Breakthrough status requires reproducible evidence and prior-art review.

evidenceDepth.E3: Independent technical corroboration or implementation evidence
evidenceDepth.E5: Independent reproduction or strong external validation

promotionStates.research_only: Interesting but insufficiently validated or too uncertain for implementation.
promotionStates.simulation_only: May be implemented only in sandbox or digital-twin environments.
promotionStates.safety_pattern_only: Reusable only as a safety or governance pattern.
promotionStates.promotion_candidate: Eligible after evidence, IP/license, security, and safety review.
promotionStates.promoted: Implemented with traceable tests, provenance, and rollback controls.

claimStatus.synthesis: New combination or interpretation of documented material.
claimStatus.breakthrough_candidate: Potentially important result requiring reproducibility and novelty review.
claimStatus.validated_result: Supported by controlled experiments and reproducible evidence.
claimStatus.breakthrough: Reserved for validated, reproducible, materially novel findings with prior-art review.

autonomyPolicy.realWorldActuation: Requires explicit authorization, policy approval, rollback, logging, and bounded scope.
